corpus:
Cascade Trail Pale Ale is brewed to a target original gravity of 1.048, equivalent to 11.9 degrees Plato. The recipe specifies a final gravity of 1.010 at the end of primary fermentation. Cascade Trail Pale Ale finishes at an alcohol by volume of 5.2 percent. The bittering schedule for Cascade Trail Pale Ale targets 38 IBU. Primary fermentation for Cascade Trail Pale Ale proceeds at 18 to 20 degrees Celsius using a British ale strain.

Solstice Imperial Stout carries a target original gravity of 1.092, equivalent to 22.1 degrees Plato. The recipe specifies a final gravity of 1.022 for Solstice Imperial Stout. Solstice Imperial Stout reaches an alcohol by volume of 9.6 percent. The bittering schedule for Solstice Imperial Stout targets 55 IBU. Solstice Imperial Stout is specified at a colour of 80 EBC, equivalent to 40 SRM. Primary fermentation for Solstice Imperial Stout proceeds at 18 to 22 degrees Celsius using a robust ale strain.

Harbor Light Lager is fermented at 9 to 12 degrees Celsius over a lagering period of three weeks. The pitching rate for Harbor Light Lager is set at 1.2 million cells per milliliter per degree Plato. When packaged in kegs, Harbor Light Lager is carbonated to 2.6 volumes of carbon dioxide. When packaged in bottles, Harbor Light Lager is carbonated to 2.4 volumes of carbon dioxide.

Ember Amber Ale finishes at an alcohol by volume of 5.5 percent. The bittering schedule for Ember Amber Ale targets 32 IBU. Ember Amber Ale is specified at a colour of 28 EBC. The pitching rate for Ember Amber Ale is set at 0.9 million cells per milliliter per degree Plato.
